keyEvents.text: Goal! Stoke City 1, Millwall 0. George Hirst (Stoke City) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Jack McGlynn with a through ball.
Luke Graham (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Jenson Metcalfe (Millwall).
